summary.text: Carrie McLeod is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from District 45 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She owns a dietetics practice and has worked in health care.

paragraphs.text: Carrie McLeod earned a B.S. in nutrition and dietetics from North Dakota State University and an M.B.A. from the University of Mary.

Her career has included owning Disease Management and Prevention Dietitians, PLLC, working as a corporate community benefit and community health improvement lead with Sanford Health, serving as a member of the clinical faculty at the University of North Dakota School of Medicine, and working as a regional clinic manager with the MeritCare Health System.
McLeod assumed office on December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, alongside fellow incumbent Scott Wagner.
The general election for the district's two seats also includes Democrats Don Lippert and Ross Lockhart.
According to the North Dakota Legislative Branch, her 2025 assignments include the Government and Veterans Affairs and Judiciary committees, and she chairs the interim Health Care Committee.
